༈rdzogs pa chen po chos nyid rang grol bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༈ rdzogs pa chen po chos nyid rang grol bzhugs/

rgya gar skad du/ /mahā san+dhi dharma dhā tu āt+ma ko nā ma/ bod ska du/ rdzogs pa chen po chos nyid rang grol zhes bya ba/ dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdod nas ma skyes 'od gsal mnyam pa'i ngang*/ /sems nyid mi g.yo 'dzin med yangs pa che/ /sku gsum lhun grub bde chen 'og min nas/ / gzhi rdzogs 'pho 'gyu med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag dang 'gro kun sems nyid sangs rgyas kyang*/ /ma rigs dbang gis srid pa'i dgon par 'khyams/ /de las thar 'dod shing rta bzang po'i lam/ /nges don snying po'i chos tshul 'dir brjod bya/ /grogs dag gting mtha' med pa'i 'khor ba 'dir/ /sdug bsngal sna tshogs rba klong 'khrugs pa ni/ /bdag 'dzin 'khrul pa'i ma rig las byung bas/ /de yi gnyen por gnas lugs lta ba gces/ /'di ltar snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams kun/ /gdod nas ma skyes ye nas mnyam pa nyid/ /grub bsal med cing rtag chad 'gro 'ong med/ / mtha' bral gnyis med chos nyid nam mkha'i ngang*/ /sna tshogs chos can ma 'dres cir snang yang*/ /snang dus nyid nas rang bzhin spros dang bral/ /phyi rol dngos min sems kyi snang lugs te/ /sems min sems las byung ba'i chos kyang min/ /yul lngar snang ba rab rib skra shad 'dra/ /med bzhin snang la gnyis su bzung bas 'khrul/ /ji ltar rmi lam sgyu ma'i glang po che/ /dpung tshogs dmag gis bskor ba'i tshul mthong tshe/ /rang las gzhan du bzung ba'i 'jigs na yang*/ /de yi rang bzhin gzhan nam sems su yod/ /de tshe phyi nang gang du'ang ma grub pas/ /rang bzhin shes rnams 'jigs sngangs rang sar grol/ /de bzhin gnyis med gnyis su gzung ba'i tshe/ /mi mkhas bden par bzung bas srid pa 'khrul/ /mkhas pa'i gnyis snang gnyis su med shes pas/ /'khor ba'i rang bzhin mya ngan 'das pa grol/ /kye ho snang 'di gdod nas ma skyes te/ /sna tshogs gnyis med me long gzugs brnyan 'dra/

/stong pa'i rang bzhin snang las tha dad min/ /chu dang rlan bzhin zung 'jug gnyis med ngang*/ /sgyu ma mtha' bral sprul pa'i grong khyer bzhin/ /skyes tsam nyid nas ma skyes gdod ma'i ngang*/ /gnas par snang yang mi gnas chos kyi sku/ / 'gag tsam nyid nas mi 'gags 'phel 'grib med/ /ji ltar snang ba de ltar ma grub cing/ /gang ltar brtags pa de ltar rang bzhin med/ /ye grol phyam gcig kun tu bzang po'i ngang*/ /gzhi rtsa dngos po med pa'i chos rnams la/ / 'di zhes ched du mi 'dzin ngos bzung med/ /mkha' bzhin byed po mi dmigs bya bas stong*/ /gang yin kun yin 'di yin gza' gtad med/ /phyogs 'dzin grub pa'i mthas sbyar khas len dang*/ /lta sgom spyod pa'i rnams grangs mang pos kyang*/ /snying po'i sems nyid gnyug ma'i don mthong dka'/ /nyan rang sems tsam rang rgyud dbu ma yang*/ /gang zag chos bdag med pa'i rnam dbye yis/ /dngos gzhi'i lta sgom mkha' sogs bzhir gol bas/ /grangs med mang po'i 'gro ba sgrub par snang*/ /bya spyod rnal 'byor bla na med spyod pa'i/ /rgyud don bskyed rdzogs bcos sgyur du mas kyang*/ /ma bcos rang bab lhun grub gnyug ma la/ /nye bar ma gyur spros pa'i drwa bas bcings/ /sems sangs 'di zhes lta sgom spyod 'bras can/ /kha cig 'du shes tshor ba 'gog pa dang*/ /la la dus gsum 'brel thag bcad nas kyang*/ /da lta'i shes pa zang thal yin zhes smra/ /gzhan dag skyes 'gag grangs su 'debs pa la/ /gnyug ma'i don zhes rtog pa'i rba rlabs g.yo/ /de bzhin rlung 'ching gnyis sbyor bde gsal la/ /rnal ma'i don zhes chags sred 'dzin pas 'ching*/ /res 'jog blang dor dra bar chud pa las/ /snying po'i don nyid nam yang mthong ba med/ /de kun blos brtags chos kyis 'khrul pas na/ /srid pa 'dir 'ching grol ba'i skabs med do/ /kye ma ri chen brtags pa ma shes pas/ /yid bzhin dor nas 'ching bu tshol bar snang*/

/rang bzhin sems nyid gnyug ma'i mchog dor nas/ /bcos bsgyur re dogs sbrul gyi gseb tu 'ching/ /'bad pa'i sems kyis nam yang grol mi 'gyur/ /btsal bya'i don gyis tshol mkhan byas pas bslad/ /e ma rang bzhin sems kyi don 'dod na/ /brtags dang dpyad pa mang pos ci byar yod/ /gang snang de yin der snang 'dzin pa med/ / 'dzin med phyogs bral blang dor mi dgos kyis/ /thams cad gtad med bcos bslad ma byed cig /yul sems snang 'di stong pa'i tshul yin na/ / stong zhes lta bas de la ci zhig dgos/ /med na bltas kyang stong par mi 'gyur bas/ /don med ngal bas de la ci byar yod/ /de bzhin bskyed rdzogs rang bzhin bsgom mi dgos/ /blang dor chos rnams ji ltar 'dzin yang sla'i/ /de nyid don du yod na 'bad mi dgos/ /med na don med sol ba gser 'gyur yin/ /de phyir blos brtags chos rnams ma grub pas/ /de la bcos bsgyur gnyen pos ma bslad cig /'dir ni bla med rdo rje snying po'i don/ /sngags dang rgyud med grub mtha'i khas len med/ /'di zhes ngos bzung lta sgom spyod 'bras med/ /thams cad mnyam rdzogs dkyil 'khor gcig gi ngang*/ /grub pa'i mtha' rdzogs lta sgom spyod 'bras rdzogs/ /'khor 'das mnyam rdzogs chos nyid brdal ba che/ /ma bcos ma grol ye nas byang chub pas/ /byar med rgyal po lhun rdzogs chos sku'i ngang*/ /sna tshogs gzugs sku sgyu ma'i rol pa ni/ /snang srid sku gsum ye shes 'du 'bral med/ / spang blang mi dmigs thams cad rnam dag ngang*/ /yangs so che 'o thams cad lhun mtho 'o/ /chos rnams lhun rdzogs thams cad mnyam pa nyid/ /ma skyes rgyal po mtha' dbus phyogs bral la/ /gzung 'dzin zhen pa med na gnyug ma'i don/ /spang blang dgag sgrub mi dgos phyam gcig pa/ /lta ba'i yang rtse rdzogs pa chen po yin/ /gtad med rgyal po 'dzin med shes par gyis/

/ched du dmigs pa thams cad 'ching ba ste/ /dmigs med gang dag shar na ye shes dngos/ /ye bab rang stong so ma gnyug ma'i don/ /'dzin med phyogs bral lta ba thag chod cig /kye ho/ sna tshogs snang ba 'di dag dgod re bro/ /ma brtags nyams dga' brtags na ngos bzung med/ /shin tu brtags na rang bzhin mtha' las 'das/ /de nyid 'byed pa'i sems la tshur bltas na/ /dus gsum mi dmigs skye 'gag gnas par med/ /kha dog dbyibs bral ngo bo ngos bzung med/ /shar bar snang dus shar sa shar mkhan med/ / phyi nang mi dmigs gzung 'dzin mtha' las 'das/ /phyi rol yul la 'phro bar snang mod kyang*/ /'phros pa med de sems la shar ba tsam/ /'phros na de tshe rang nyid bems po yis/ /skad cig rig pa tshan pa gnyis su 'gyur/ / 'char gzhi gtan med ye grol nam mkha' 'dra/ /shar ba gnyis med me long gzugs brnyan 'dra/ /don la gnyis med chu dang rba rlabs 'dra/ /blang dor mi dgos rdzogs pa chen po'i don/ /rang bzhin ye nas dag pa'i sangs rgyas yin/ /snang sems gdod nas rang bzhin med pa la/ /de ring dpal ldan bla mas bstan pa rtogs/ /da ni thams cad chos skur thag chod pas/ /yin min the tshom sgro 'dogs kun dang bral/ /su la'ang mi dri sems nyid rnal ma'i don/ /byar med gnyug ma'i ngo bo mthong ba yin/ /de tshe 'phro gnas chos sku'i rol pa las/ /spang blang mi dgos gang shar rgyan du che/ /gnas na'ang mi g.yo chos nyid gcig gi ngang*/ /thams cad lhun rdzogs 'pho 'gyur med pa yin/ /da ni dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs par sleb/ /bde chen lhun grub gzhi rdzogs kun tu bzang*/ /dus rnams kun tu 'pho 'gyur med pas na/ / thams cad phyam gcig gdod ma'i sar grol lo/ /kye ma phyogs ris 'dzin pa'i sems yod par/ /thar pa'i skal med 'ching byed de rang nyid/ /ji srid phyogs bral mthar 'dzin grol ba na/ /gnyis med don yin gzhan zhig mtshon du med/

/bltas pas mi mthong dpyad pas rnyed pa min/ /'di zhes mi mtshon tha mal rang bab la/ /zhen pa'i sems kyis 'ching grol ma byed cig /gang la gnyis med mtha' bral 'dod na yang*/ /mtha' bral mtha' ru snying po'i sems nyid 'ching*/ /bden gnyis 'dod kyang de yi mthar lhung zhing*/ /zung 'jug 'dod kyang gnyug ma'i gnas lugs min/ /gang ltar brtags shing zhen pa'i gzeb tu 'ching*/ /thog med gzung 'dzin 'khrul pas ma chog pas/ /da dung nan brtags blo yi ri mos 'ching*/ /kye ma 'khrul pa'i sems ni snying re rje/ /'di zhes ngos bzung yod na lta ba min/ /sna tshogs spros pa'i gzeb yin dgos pa med/ /gang shar rtsis gdab med pa'i rig pa la/ /yangs dog mtho dman med kyis zhen 'dzin thong*/ /'di yin gza' gtad bral ba'i snang sems la/ /spang gnyen bcos bsgyur ma byed gang bab zhog /'di ni nges don snying po'i mthar thug yin/ /sna tshogs chos kun mnyam pa'i rang bzhin la/ /gang shar de yin gnyis med ye shes yin/ /blo yis ma rtog yid kyis tshol khro zhog /gzung bas ma 'chings 'dzin pas ma bslad cig /gang zhig chos kun nam mkha' 'drar shes shing*/ /sgyu ma mnyam mthong zhen pa'i yul med na/ /gnyis med rang bzhin lta ba'i rgyal po mchog /mtha' bral rtogs pa'i tshad yin ngo mtshar che/ /srid zhi gnyis med rig pa zang kha ma/ /rang ngo shes pa gzhi rtsa dngos po med/ /'ching grol gnyis med rdzogs pa chen po'i don/ /'gro kun sems la ma lus rgyun du gnas/ /de nyid mthong phyir dpe bral zab mo'i don/ /dri med 'od zer shar bas bstan nas song*/ /snang sems 'dzin med sgyu ma'i rtsed mo las/ /phyogs bral rig pa lta bar mkhyen 'tshal lo/ /rdzogs pa chen po chos nyid rang grol las/ /gzhi rtogs pas grol ba'i le'u ste dang po'o// //rdo rje rtse mo mchog gi gnyis med lam/ /gang shar rig pa der 'dzin med pa'i ngang*/

/cher gyis bltas la cham gyis bzhag pa'i tshe/ /ngang dwangs shes pa chu la chu bzhag bzhin/ /gnyis med rang grol bde gsal mi rtog 'char/ /yang gcig 'phros kyang mi g.yo brtan par gnas/ /de tshe skye med sems nyid chos sku'i ngang*/ /shar grol rig pa gzugs sku mya ngan 'da'/ /spang blang mi dgos 'phro gnas gang bder thongs/ /shar gnas zhi lhag thabs shes zung 'jug la/ / blo yis ma bcos bzo rig ma byed cig /gal te dgag sgrub spang blang 'ga' yod na/ /de tshe re dogs gnyis 'dzin gzeb tu 'ching*/ /'dod sar mi phyin gol sar ltung bas na/ /gang shar don la spang blang med pa gces/ /grogs dag sems ni go bzlog rnga mo 'dra/ /bzung na 'gro la spros na brtan par gnas/ /rang bab glod na rang grol gnyug ma'i ngang*/ /gzung 'dzin rang sar grol bas blo bde rnyed/ /de bas ched du dmigs pa'i sems btang ste/ / dmigs med gang shar bcos bslad med par bzhag /gzung 'dzin gnyis med rang grol chen por gnas/ /'gag med rig pa gsal stong ye shes 'char/ / ༈ sna tshogs 'phro bas snang ba'i thabs yin la/ /grol ba'i lhag mthong shes rab lhun gyis grub/ /de nyid ngang gnas ngang dwangs zhi gnas la/ /bde gsal mi rtog bsam gtan lhun gyis grub/ /ma byas mi 'jig rang bab chen po 'o/ /'gyu ba seng la gnas pas rnam par gnon/ /rang bab 'phro gnas yon tan mtha' las te/ /'phros bas ma bying sems gnas zhen pa 'gog /lhag mthong shes rab nyon mongs rtsad 'byin zhing*/ /gzugs dang gzugs med sems las rnam par grol/ /gnas pa'i mi rgod spros pa'i drwa ba 'gog /zhi gnas ye shes nyon mongs mgo gnon zhing*/ /'dod pa'i sems las rnam par grol ba yin/ / ༈ de 'dra'i sgom pa ma byas lhun grub la/ /spang blang gnyis med rang sems grogs su 'char/ /gzung 'dzin rang grol yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /sems sangs bla med mnyam gzhag chen po yin/

/ ༈ de nas langs pa'i mnyam gzhag rgya yan du/ /snang ba'i rang bzhin rmi lam sgyu ma dang*/ /smig sgyu mig yor brag cha gzugs brnyan dang*/ / chu zla sprul pa lta bur ngo bos stong*/ /med bzhin snang la sang sing khral ma khrol/ /ban bun 'al 'ol yal yol phyad ma phyod/ /snang la der 'dzin med pa'i ngang la spyad/ / ༈ bar 'ga' nges 'byung skyo shas gting nas bskyed/ / rtag tu 'chi bsam blo sna btsan thabs bstungs/ /dag snangaphyogs med mos gus rgyun chad med/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshogs gnyis lam la 'bad/ /dge sdig las 'bras 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam/ /mdor na sems la dran pa'i mel tshe yis/ /rtag tu bag yod shes bzhin bsten par bya/ /res 'ga' snang srid sgyu ma'i rtsal sbyong gi /mnyam rjes bsre zhing rkyen ngan lam du bslang*/ /lta sgom don la sna tshogs bogs 'byin zhing*/ /tshogs drug rang grol sgo lnga'i gzigs mo lta/ /skyabs su ngag dwangs rtse gcig don la bzhag /rtse gcig zhi gnas ting 'dzin 'grub par 'gyur/ /de bzhin rig pa dal du mi gzhug par/ /phyi nang kun rtog dug lnga 'phror bcug la/ /skad cig rang grol lhag mthong rtsal sbyang bya/ /dgag sgyur rkyen ngan sems kyi gzigs mor 'char/ / ༈ res 'ga' ri rtse dur khrod lung stong sogs/ / dga' 'jigs mya ngan skye ba'i gnas song nas/ /lus 'di mchong rgyug gar dang phyag rgyar bsgyur/ /ngag ni ca co glu len 'o dod 'bod/ /sems ni 'gro drug bde sdug sna tshogs bsam/ /skad cig mi dal brtson pas rang grol sbyang*/ /lta sgom spyod pa thog tu phebs sam blta/ /de rjes snang srid rmi lam sgyu mar sbyang*/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub myur du thob/ /mi mthun rkyen ngan bar chad ma lus sel/ ༈ bar 'ga' nad gdon cho 'phrul che ba na/ / mtsho gling nags tshal brag rong shing gcig sogs/ /'dre dang 'byung po rgyu ba'i gnas song nas/

/skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bla ma'i mos gus bya/ /de rjes lus ni ri rab tsam sprul nas/ /gang la ci 'dod dum bur phyogs bcur 'thor/ /bgegs rnams tshim zhing 'gro drug lan chags sbyang*/ /de nas nad gdon 'drer snang 'drer 'dzin kun/ /sems su thag bcad sems ni stong pa'i ngang*/ /dran bsam yid kyi tshol khro kun bzhag la/ /thams cad phyam gcig snyems bral nyal la bsdad/ /sna tshogs cho 'phrul rang byung rang zhir bzhag /des ni nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /sems kyi bde sdug spang blang med pa dang*/ /thams cad mkha' ltar gzung 'dzin med rtogs shing*/ / gnyug ma'i ngang la rig pa'i rtsal dbang thob/ /gzhan yang nyin mtshan dus drug 'di ltar sbyang*/ /tho rangs ngang dwangs nam mkha' lta bu la/ /rtog med shes pa gza' skar bzhin du bzhag /snga dro 'phro gnas gnyis su med pa la/ / skad cig rang grol lhag mthong rjen par bzhag /gung la dag snang mos gus phyogs med la/ /sna tshogs chos kun rmi lam sgyu mar sbyang*/ /phyi dro nges 'byung skyo shas bskyed pa dang*/ /snying nas mi rtag 'chi ba dran par bya/ /srod la phung po tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang*/ /byams dang snying rje bde gsal mi rtog sbyang*/ / gung la sems nyid skye ba med pa'i ngang*/ /rig pa'i 'phro 'du 'jug pa thim par nyal/ /gnyid dang rmi lam 'od gsal chen por 'char/ /de ltar spyod lam dus drug rnam sbyangs pas/ /'khor ba'i kun rtog bag chags rang zhi nas/ /sems nyid rang grol mya ngan 'das gzhir 'gro/ /spyan dang mngon shes yon tan sna tshogs 'grub/ /dang por ngan pa'i rmi lam bzang por 'gyur/ /bar du zin dang tha ma dbyings su nub/ /de tshe 'khor ba mya ngan 'das par grol/ /sa dang lam rdzogs bskyed rdzogs mthar phyin te/ /tshe 'di nyid la sems nyid rdzogs sangs rgya/ /'di ni nges don snying po'i theg pa yin/ /gnad kyi snying po thog tu khel ba'i rtags/

/rim gyis sbyangs pa las ni 'di ltar 'byung*/ /snying nas mi rtag blo sna thung ba dang*/ /skyo shas nges 'byung snying rje tshad med skye/ /dag snang mos gus rtogs pa phyogs med 'char/ /chags zhen rang grol dngos 'dzin 'khrul pa zhig /de tshe ma nor lam du tshud pa'i rtags/ /ches cher gong du 'phel bas sa mchog 'grub/ / chos kun ma skyes sgyu ma'i rang bzhin du/ /lta sgom spyod pas legs par rtsal sbyangs la/ /snying po'i sems nyid thar pa'i khang bzang du/ /chos nyid 'od gsal gtan srid zin par 'gyur/ /nam zhig rnal 'byor 'byung bzhi'i phung po deng*/ /de tshe sa chu me rlung rnam par shes/ /nam mkha' chos sku'i 'od gsal 'grub pa'i tshe/ /tshogs drug yul dbang kun gzhi'i rnam par shes/ / kun gzhi la zhugs de nyid chos skur thim/ /de tshe snang mched thob pa nyer thob pa/ /shin tu mi rtog 'od gsal rnam pa bzhi/ /rim gyis shar bas rang bzhin brgyad cu nub/ /rang ngo shes pas chos sku'i dbyings su grol/ /de nas longs sku rigs lnga'i bar do yang*/ /bsam gtan dag pa'i zhag lngar rim gyis 'char/ /rang ngo shes pas longs skur grol ba'i tshe/ /sprul sku'i bar dor sna tshogs rnam 'phro bas/ /'gro ba'i don byas slar yang longs skur thim/ /longs sku chos sku'i ngang du rab thim pas/ /chos sku mi g.yo bde klong gcig tu 'khyil/ /sku dang ye shes nang gsal 'du 'bral med/ /'char gzhi'i rnam par phra ba ye shes su/ /thams cad mkhyen pa 'byed pa med par bzhugs/ /mkha' bzhin ma skyes 'gag med lhun gyis grub/ /gdul bya yod na de la phyir gsal du/ /longs sku rigs lnga sprul sku'i 'char gzhir snang*/ / slar yang sngon bzhin gzhi thog lhun gyis grub/ /'di ni 'bring rnams bar do grol ba yin/ /tha mas srid pa'i bar dor rim shar nas/ /rmi lam bzhin du sna tshogs snang ba'i tshe/ /bden med ngang dwangs sgyu ma bskyed rdzogs dang*/

/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /'khor ba'i ru bzlog mngal sgo dgag dang 'dam/ /dag pa'i zhing du rnam shes 'pho bar bya/ /phyi mar rang snang chos la spyod pa'i lus/ /yon tan bdun dang ldan pa thob nas grol/ /'di ni yang zab gnad kyi gdams pa yin/ /grogs dag nyin mtshan mi dal brtson pa yis/ /lta ba'i rtsal sbyong sgom pa'i nyams len dang*/ /spyod pa'i bogs 'byin don la nan tan bya/ /tha mal phyogs su skad cig mi btang bar/ /ji skad bshad la sgrub pa'i brtson 'grus brtsam/ /da lta'i sems la rang dbang ma thob na/ /phyi ma'i sems la grol ba thob mi 'gyur/ /tshe ni myur 'gro 'khor ba pha mtha' med*/ /'di las da res thar pa'i thabs 'tshal lo/ /mdor na thog med 'khor bar 'khyams pa yang*/ /gnyis 'dzin goms pa'i bdag 'dzin las byung bas/ /rtag tu bden med stong pa'i rang bzhin 'gros/ /sems nyid rgyal po bya rtsol med par sbyang*/ /ji srid bdag 'dzin 'khrul pa'i sems yod par/ /lta sgom rtsal sbyang dge sdig blang dor gces/ /nam zhig gnyis 'dzin rang sar grol ba na/ /spang gnyen mi dgos lta sgom chos las 'das/ de tshe snang srid chos skur shar ba yin/ /kye ho grogs dag 'khor 'das gzhan med de/ /thams cad dbyings dang sems nyid rol pa'i ngang*/ /gzhi grol lam grol 'bras bu ye nas grol/ /thams cad rang grol sgyu ma'i rtsed mo la/ /'di yin gza' gtad med pa'i snang ba shar/ /thams cad de yin ched 'dzin zhen pa thong*/ /mthar thug don la 'khrul pa 'khrul mkhan med/ /sgom dang mi sgom med par thag chod pas/ / spyod dang spyad bya mang pos ci zhig bya/ /gang snang don la 'dzin zhen med pa yin/ /chags med zhen med rtsis med rig med bya/ /bdag med stong pa gnyis med lhun gyis grub/ /'khor bar mi gnas mya ngan 'das mi gnas/ / mdo rgyud man ngag kun gyi dgongs pa yin/

/'di ni rgya sras dri med 'od zer gyis/ /snying po'i gdams pa ma lus bstan nas song*/ /phyi rabs tshe 'dir grol ba gnyer 'dod pas/ /zab mo'i don 'dir zhugs la brtson par mdzod/ /rdzogs pa chen po chos nyid rang grol las/ /lam bsgoms pa'i grol ba'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// // de ltar gzhi lam rtogs pa mthar phyin nas/ /dri med rang bzhin sems nyid rnam dag tu/ /sna tshogs sems kyi 'jug pa kun nub ste/ /dbyings dang ye shes ro gcig gyur pa ni/ /chos sku rgyal po'i gtan srid zin pa yin/ /de tshe mkha' ltar rang bzhin spros dang bral/ /rgya chad phyogs lhung kun las 'das pa ni/ /dag pa gnyis ldan chos nyid 'pho 'gyur med/ /de nyid ngang las lhun grub longs sku ni/ /rang snang rnam dag 'og min stug po bkod/ / 'od gsal ye shes rnam lnga'i zhing khams su/ /zhi dang khro tshul rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /steng 'og phyogs mtshams nam mkha' khyab par snang*/ / gtso 'khor grangs med rtogs pa gcig gi ngang*/ /mtshan dang dpe byad 'od zer 'bar ba ste/ /kun kyang sku lnga ye shes rnam pa lnga/ /mi g.yo mi gsung brjod 'das chen po ni/ /stobs sogs yon tan rgya mtsho'i pha rol phyin/ / mdzad pa'i 'phrin las sku gsum cho 'phrul 'gyed/ /'di ni ye shes longs sku'i ston pa yin/ /de nyid ngang las gdul bya'i 'jig rten du/ /'dul byed ston pa rigs lngar snang ba ni/ /mkha' zla'i gzugs brnyan chu zlar snang ba bzhin/ /sar gnas 'gro la 'og min mngon dga' dang*/ /rin chen yongs gang bde ba can dang ni/ /las rab grub par rnam snang mi bskyod pa/ /rin 'byung 'od dpag don grub rigs lnga nyid/ /gti mug zhe sdang nga rgyal 'dod chags dang*/ /phrag dog sbyang phyir so so'i ston par snang*/ /gzugs bzang me long bstan pas don mdzad de/ /rgyal ba'i sku dang 'od zer 'khyil ba nyid/ / rang gi lus dang mtshungs par ma mthong nas/

/des na chos nyid rtogs pa rab sbyangs pas/ /sa bcu'i dri ma rnam bcu rim sbyangs te/ /kun tu 'od la 'god pa'i 'phrin las mdzad/ /gdul bya ji srid 'dul byed snang ba ni/ / nam mkhas gar khyab kun tu mtshungs par khyab/ /'di ni rang bzhin sprul pa'i sku zhes bya/ /de nyid ngang las 'gro drug 'jig rten du/ /thub pa drug gi rnam 'phrul mi zad pas/ /'gro ba'i don mdzad chos tshul bsam las ston/ / rang dang snang ngor mthun pa'i sku gsung thugs/ /sna tshogs mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo nyid/ /ji ltar snang bas de ltar don mdzad pa/ /'di ni 'gro 'dul sprul pa'i sku zhes bya/ /de nyid ngang las sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku/ /bzo dang rang byon sku gsung thugs kyi rten/ /lha dang ri mo ye ge la sogs dang*/ /rdzing dang zam pa khang bzang skyed mos tshal/ /sa chu me rlung pad+ma dpag bsam shing*/ /nor bu sgron me sman dang kha zas mchog /gos dang rgyan sogs nye 'khor sprul nas kyang*/ /gnas skabs bde skyid mthar thug legs pa'i lam/ /gang la 'gro kun 'god pa'i phrin las can/ /sems med bems por snang bas don byed pa/ /rgyal ba'i thugs rje rmad byung mtha' yas ni/ /sna tshogs ma nges sprul pa'i sku zhes bya/ /de ltar sku gsum ston pa dpag med kyang*/ /gdul bya med tshe 'dul byed dbyings su nub/ /sngon bzhin de yi rang bzhin rnam dbye med/ /de yang mas rim gcig la gcig thim nas/ /lhun grub chos sku bde klong gcig tu 'khyil/ /nang gsal 'char gzhi ye shes phra mo'i ngang*/ /thams cad mkhyen nyid zhi la rtag bzhugs nas/ /gdul bya yod na yas rim sngon bzhin snang*/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i don mdzad do/ /'di ni mthar phyin nges pa'i 'bras bu ste/ /dri med 'od zer shar bas bstan nas song*/ /skal ldan nges pa'i lam bzang 'dod pa dag /lhun grub sa la gtan srid zin par mdzod/ /rdzogs pa chen po chos nyid rang grol las/

/'bras bu mchog gi grol ba'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// // de ltar chos tshul zab cing rgya che ba/ /dri med 'od zer shar bas snang byas pa'i/ /dge bas 'gro kun srid pa'i mun bsal te/ /sems nyid sangs rgyas pad+mo rgyas par shog /snying po'i man ngag sprin gyi phreng ba 'di/ /gangs ri thod dkar mgul du legs bkod pa'i/ /skal sdan bdud rtsi'i char gyis tshim byas te/ /lam bzang snang bas phyogs bcur rgyas par shog /rdzogs pa chen po chos nyid rang grol zhes bya ba/ /dpal o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po seng ge sgra sgrogs kyis rjes su bzung nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnal 'byor pa dri med 'od zer gyis gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul du bkod pa'o// // sarba maṅga laṃ// //
